fact_text: Beta measures how much a stock moves against the KSE-100: a beta of 1 moves with the index, above 1 is more volatile than the index, and below 1 moves less.

fact_text: Beta worked example: if the index rises 10% and a stock rises only 7%, the stock's beta is 0.7.

fact_text: The analyst says blue-chip stocks usually have a beta below 1, so they move less than the index.

fact_text: Paid-up capital is the money shareholders have actually paid in: shares issued multiplied by face value, plus any share premium charged on top.
